[NSTG.9.2] **Restore is setup arrange, not replay.** A restored entry is starting
state, not a cache write ([RARC.5.7.10]): the seed emits no stream
event and drives no callback, so restoring the cache neither re-persists it nor
re-fires write-through. A recording carries each restored entry in its prelude
([RFCS.26.1]), so a replay starts from the restored cache without the
integrator restoring it again. The integrator parses each persisted JSON value to a
`ds_json_t` and passes it to the seed; the engine re-serialises canonically, so a
restored value is byte-identical to the value the running engine originally wrote
([IARC.12.2]).
